mapper.select: select w.record_id, w.factory_id, w.workorder_id, w.process_id, w.process_code, w.process_name, w.order_num, w.is_outsource, w.doc_type, w.vendor_id, w.vendor_code, w.vendor_name, w.unit_price, w.plan_qty, w.expected_date, w.remark, p.biz_type from qxx_pro_workorder_process w left join qxx_pro_process p on p.process_id = w.process_id where w.workorder_id = #{workorderId} and w.factory_id = #{factoryId} order by w.order_num asc, w.record_id asc
mapper.delete: delete from qxx_pro_workorder_process where workorder_id = #{workorderId} and factory_id = #{factoryId}
mapper.insert:

(#{it.workorderId}, #{it.processId}, #{it.processCode}, #{it.processName}, #{it.orderNum}, #{it.isOutsource}, #{it.docType}, #{it.vendorId}, #{it.vendorCode}, #{it.vendorName}, #{it.unitPrice}, #{it.planQty}, #{it.expectedDate}, #{it.remark}, #{it.createBy}, sysdate())
